# Hanzi Writer

`hanzi-writer-3.7.3.min.js` is the unmodified distribution from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hanzi-writer@3.7.3/dist/hanzi-writer.min.js.
Its MIT license is included in `hanzi-writer-LICENSE.txt`.

Practice loads character data on demand from the pinned `hanzi-writer-data@2.0.1`
package on jsDelivr. Character data is not bundled here and requires connectivity.
It has a separate Arphic Public License:
https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/blob/master/ARPHICPL.TXT.
The source dataset follows PRC stroke conventions, including for Traditional
characters. The practice UI explains that Taiwan conventions can differ.
